16.name: Asha hides the pad
16.description: Asha slips the folded pad into her jacket pocket, concealing the room number and attending's name.
evidence: the pad folded once and slid into the inner pocket of her jacket where the room number and the attending's name went out of sight

16.name: Asha intercepts the child on the stairs
16.description: Asha moves to the foot of the stairs and meets the boy on the third step before Claire can fully rise.
evidence: She crossed to the foot of the stairs before Claire had finished pushing herself up from the table, and met the older one—a boy in mismatched pajama pants, hair flattened on one side—at the third step from the bottom

16.name: Claire moves to make tea
16.description: Claire shifts toward the kettle, taking on the task she can still manage.
evidence: Behind her Claire was already moving toward the kettle the way a person moves when she has been given one task she can still perform

16.name: Asha notes hospital and paperwork barriers
16.description: The scene establishes that the hospital is forty minutes away and that Claire lacks the signed paperwork needed to bring a non-spouse onto the unit.
evidence: The hospital was a forty-minute drive at this hour, the unit would not let a non-spouse onto the floor without paperwork Claire had not signed

16.name: Boy looks for his father
16.description: The boy on the stairs looks toward the kitchen, expecting to find his father whose car is absent.
evidence: the boy on the stairs was looking past Asha toward the kitchen for the father whose car was not in the driveway

16.name: Asha guides the boy toward the kitchen
16.description: Asha places a hand on the boy's shoulder and turns him toward the kitchen, positioning herself to block the stairs.
evidence: Asha set her palm lightly on the boy's shoulder where it met the collar of his pajama top and turned him by that small pressure toward the kitchen
She kept her body angled between him and the table where the pad had been

16.name: Asha speaks calmly to the boy
16.description: Using an ordinary morning voice, Asha asks the boy whether he wants his toast cut in halves or quarters.
evidence: asked him, in the ordinary voice she used for ordinary mornings, whether he wanted the toast cut in halves or in quarter

16.name: Asha shields the table from him
16.description: Asha positions her body between the boy and the table where the pad had been, signaling guarded control of the situation.
evidence: She kept her body angled between him and the table where the pad had been

16.name: Asha asks about cutting toast
16.description: Asha speaks in a deliberately ordinary tone and asks whether the boy wants his toast cut in halves or quarters.
evidence: asked him, in the ordinary voice she used for ordinary mornings, whether he wanted the toast cut in halves or in quarters

16.name: Asha receives Rosa's first message
16.description: As she crosses the kitchen, Asha reads a buzzed phone message from Rosa instructing her to get the signature and clear the board.
evidence: Her phone buzzed once against her hip on the way across the linoleum, Rosa again, and she read it without slowing—contact and status received, kids are there, get the signature and clear the board

16.name: Asha releases the boy at the counter
16.description: Asha lets go of the boy's shoulder only when he is close enough to reach the counter and take a glass himself.
evidence: let her hand drop from the boy's shoulder only when he was close enough to the counter to reach for a glass on his own

16.name: Claire silently acknowledges the situation
16.description: Claire hears what is happening, does not turn around, and chooses to keep doing the task she has been given.
evidence: Claire, at the stove, did not turn around; she lifted the kettle off the burner a beat before it whistled, which told Asha that Claire had heard everything and was choosing, for now, the one task she had been given

16.name: Asha serves toast and reveals the form
16.description: Asha places toast at the boy's elbow and slides the authorization form from under the plate so it lands in front of Claire.
evidence: Asha set a plate of toast at the boy's elbow, halves not quarters because he had nodded at halves, and in the same motion she slid the authorization form out from under the plate's edge so the top sheet came to rest in front of Claire at the corner of the counter

16.name: Asha places the pen beside the form
16.description: Asha sets a pen next to the authorization form without looking at it, keeping her attention on the boy.
evidence: The pen she set beside it she did not look at; she kept her eyes on the boy

16.name: Asha receives Rosa's second message
16.description: Asha reads another urgent message from Rosa telling her to put the paper in front of Claire immediately and then turns the phone face-down.
evidence: Her phone buzzed once against her hip and she read it without lifting it far from her side—Rosa, the line short, the words get the paper in front of her now, no gaps, clear the board—and then turned the screen face-down on the counter near the sugar bowl

16.name: Rosa instructs Claire to sign
16.description: Rosa directs Claire to put the paper in front of her and sign it, then turns the screen face-down on the counter.
evidence: Rosa, the line short, the words get the paper in front of her now, no gaps, clear the board—and then turned the screen face-down on the counter near the sugar bowl.

16.name: Claire hesitates before signing
16.description: Claire studies the form passively and pauses with her fingers on it before taking up the pen.
evidence: Claire looked at the form the way she had looked at the kettle, as a thing she had been given to do, and rested two fingers on the upper margin without yet picking up the pen.

16.name: Asha distracts the boy with questions
16.description: Asha speaks to the boy in an ordinary tone, asking about his brother's preferences while avoiding Claire.
evidence: Asha asked the boy, in the same ordinary voice, whether his brother liked jam or butter, and did not look at Claire at all.

16.name: Asha steps away from Claire
16.description: Asha shifts back from the counter so Claire is no longer signing under her shadow and keeps watching the boy.
evidence: Asha shifted her weight back a half step from the corner of the counter, enough that Claire was no longer signing under the shadow of her arm, and kept her eyes on the boy working the jam knife across his toast in uneven swipes.

16.name: Asha reads Rosa's message
16.description: Asha notices the phone pulse, reads Rosa's instruction without picking it up, and lets the screen go dark again.
evidence: The phone by the sugar bowl pulsed once more against the laminate, and she read Rosa's line without picking it up—signature now, clear the board—and let the screen go dark again.

16.name: Claire signs the form
16.description: Claire slowly signs the form, completing her last name without flourish.
evidence: Claire's hand moved; the pen tracked the line at the bottom of the form, slower than a signature usually is, the loop of her last name closing without flourish.

16.name: Asha avoids looking at the signed page
16.description: Asha deliberately does not look down at the signed form, focusing instead on the boy's attention.
evidence: Asha did not look down at the page even when Claire set the pen beside it, because the boy had glanced up at the sound and she wanted his eyes to find hers instead of his mother's hand.

16.name: Asha redirects the boy's attention
16.description: Asha asks the boy about milk in a glass or blue cup, trying to keep his focus on her rather than on Claire.
evidence: She asked him whether his brother took milk in a glass or in the blue cup, and behind that question she heard Claire draw the kind of breath a person takes when something has been done that cannot be undone in the next hour.

16.name: Asha takes the signed form
16.description: Asha quietly pulls the signed form toward herself after Claire has signed it, signaling that the decision is now irreversible.
evidence: Asha slid the signed form toward herself with two fingers along its bottom edge
Claire draw the kind of breath a person takes when something has been done that cannot be undone in the next hour

16.name: Asha avoids acknowledging the signature
16.description: Asha deliberately does not look at Claire's signature and keeps her attention on the boy instead.
evidence: She did not look down at the signature; her eyes stayed on the boy

16.name: Asha answers the boy's breakfast question
16.description: Asha responds to the boy's unspoken question about whether his brother needs a fork, maintaining the breakfast routine.
evidence: she answered some small thing he had not quite asked about whether his brother needed a fork

16.name: Asha receives Rosa's terse instruction
16.description: Asha checks her phone and sees Rosa's brief message telling her to clear the board and go.
evidence: The phone by the sugar bowl pulsed once more and went still
when she turned it a quarter inch to read it, Rosa's line was shorter than the others—clear the board, go

16.name: Asha ignores Rosa's message
16.description: Asha lets the phone screen go dark without replying, choosing not to answer Rosa immediately.
evidence: she let the screen darken without reply

16.name: Claire remains frozen after signing
16.description: Claire stays seated with her hand on the counter where she signed, visibly affected by the completed action.
evidence: Claire was still sitting where she had signed, her hand now flat on the counter where the form had been

16.name: Asha hides the signed form in her bag
16.description: Asha folds the signed page and slips it into her bag without interrupting the boy's breakfast.
evidence: Asha folded the page once along its existing crease and slid it into the inside pocket of the bag at her feet without breaking the rhythm of the boy's breakfast

16.name: Asha serves the boy milk
16.description: Asha pours milk into the blue cup and places it beside the boy's plate, continuing to care for him while avoiding Claire.
evidence: Asha reached past the cereal box for the blue cup, took the milk from the counter, and poured with her eyes on the rim of the cup rather than on Claire
She put the cup beside the boy's plate

16.name: Asha tidies the boy's place setting
16.description: Asha tucks a napkin under the cup and asks about the boy's brother's preference for crusts, keeping the domestic routine going.
evidence: and tucked a paper napkin under the edge of it, asking him without looking up whether his brother liked the crust on or off

16.name: serves boy's drink
16.description: Asha places a cup beside the boy's plate and adjusts a napkin while quietly checking on his preferences.
evidence: She put the cup beside the boy's plate and tucked a paper napkin under the edge of it, asking him without looking up whether his brother liked the crust on or off, and he answered off without lifting his head from the toast.

16.name: receives Rosa's first message
16.description: Asha notices her phone pulse and reads Rosa's first instruction to go with papers in hand.
evidence: The phone by the sugar bowl pulsed once against the laminate, a short single beat this time, and when she turned it a quarter inch the line from Rosa read paper in hand, go;

16.name: delays after reading message
16.description: Asha lets the phone go dark and pauses instead of acting immediately.
evidence: she let the screen darken and did not move yet

16.name: reads Claire's hesitation
16.description: Asha notices Claire's subtle hand movement and understands Claire is waiting for direction without asking.
evidence: Claire's hand on the counter shifted slightly, the fingers spreading and then settling, and Asha understood that Claire had read the angle of her shoulder and was waiting to be told what came next without having to ask.

16.name: buys time with cup
16.description: Asha nudges the cup closer to the boy's plate as a way of delaying the inevitable.
evidence: She slid the cup a half inch closer to the boy's plate, the way a person buys another minute, and kept her gaze on the rim.

16.name: receives Rosa's evacuation order
16.description: Asha reads Rosa's second message telling her to clear everyone out and leave immediately.
evidence: The phone gave one more short beat against the laminate, and when Asha turned it she read Rosa's last line: clear them out, leave now.

16.name: starts clearing the table
16.description: Asha sets the phone down and begins removing the boy's plate from the table.
evidence: She set the phone face down and reached for the boy's plate, sliding it out from under the heel of toast he had not finished

16.name: asks about shoes
16.description: Asha quietly asks the boy whether his shoes are by the door, signaling an imminent departure.
evidence: and asked him in the same low voice whether he had his shoes by the door

16.name: withholds answer from Claire
16.description: Asha recognizes Claire is about to ask something she cannot answer and decides not to respond.
evidence: Claire's hand lifted finally from the counter, more reflex than decision, and Asha registered the motion without turning toward it; what Claire was about to ask was something Asha could not answer from this room, and the not-answering would have to stand.

16.name: cleans knife and prepares to leave
16.description: Asha wipes the jam knife, drops it in the sink, and crouches for a bag, preparing to go.
evidence: She wiped the jam knife on the napkin, dropped it into the sink, and crouched for the bag at her

16.name: Asha leaves without answering
16.description: Asha decides she cannot answer the question from the kitchen and leaves the room, letting the unanswered issue stand.
evidence: the not-answering would have to stand.
She wiped the jam knife on the napkin, dropped it into the sink, and crouched for the bag at her feet
She lifted the strap to her shoulder
went out through the side door without looking back at Claire

16.name: Asha instructs the boy about the blue cup
16.description: Before leaving, Asha tells the boy that his brother likes the blue cup so he will know which one to carry upstairs.
evidence: told the boy his brother liked the blue cup so he would know which one to carry up

16.name: Asha carries the hidden bag to her car
16.description: Asha walks quickly down the side path and narrow drive to her car with the bag containing a folded form.
evidence: Outside, the air on the side path was cooler than the kitchen had been
Asha walked the length of the narrow drive to her car without slowing
the bag's strap shortening against her shoulder
the folded form a flat weight against the inside lining

16.name: Asha texts Rosa that she is moving
16.description: Asha sends Rosa a brief message saying the paper is in hand and she is moving now.
evidence: thumbed out a single line to Rosa: paper in hand, moving now

16.name: Asha drives off without waiting
16.description: Asha does not wait for Rosa's reply, starts the car, and pulls away from the curb without looking back at the house.
evidence: She did not wait for a reply
she set the phone in the cup holder face up and turned the key
Asha put the car into gear and pulled away from the curb without looking up at the house

16.name: Rosa deletes the message thread
16.description: Across the city, Rosa reads Asha's text immediately and erases the recent exchange history from her phone.
evidence: somewhere across the city Rosa, who had read it on the first vibration, opened the thread and cleared it, message by message, until the line of exchanges between them from the past three days was gone from the device in her hand

16.name: Asha begins the hospital trip
16.description: As Asha drives away, the planned hour-long trip to the hospital begins on her terms, with no immediate demand for explanation from the kitchen behind her.
evidence: the hour to the hospital began the way she had arranged for it to begin
with no one in the kitchen behind her required to say anything yet

16.name: checks wrist number remains legible
16.description: She confirms that the number on her wrist is still readable.
evidence: the number was still legible
The number on her wrist

16.name: presses thumb to secure marking
16.description: She presses her thumb against the skin to make sure nothing will rub off before she arrives.
evidence: she pressed the pad of her thumb against the skin to be sure none of it would lift off on the steering wheel before she got there

16.name: drives forward through changing light
16.description: As the light changes, she eases the vehicle forward.
evidence: The light changed and she eased forward

16.name: keeps folded paper steady on passenger seat
16.description: The folded paper remains flat on the passenger seat against the canvas lining where her palm had left it.
evidence: the folded form on the passenger seat still flat against the canvas lining where her palm had left it

16.name: avoids checking the time
16.description: She deliberately does not look at the time again.
evidence: She did not check the time again

16.name: focuses on arriving with paper and wrist number together
16.description: She treats the wrist number and the paper as the two things that must arrive together and limits her attention to the next block.
evidence: The number on her wrist and the paper at her side were the two things that had to arrive together
for the length of the next block that was as far ahead as she let herself look
